text: This report recommends names for 2 public lanes intersecting Wellesley Street East and Church Street in the Church Wellesley Neighbourhood. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Dapper Lane" for the existing public lane west of Church Street extending northerly from Wellesley Street East. 2. Approve the name "Anvil Alley" for the existing public lane north of Wellesley Street East extending easterly from Church Street.
